ValidationRule.description: This rule makes sure the Phone Number field follows a prescribed format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), $Setup.ER_Validation_Rules_Settings__c.VRBE11_Valid_Phone__c = false, ISPICKVAL(ER_Country_Code__c, "BE"), IsConverted, /* Ensures validation only runs when converting the lead */ NOT(ISBLANK(Phone)), NOT(REGEX(Phone, "(^$)|^[+]?([0-9]*[/\\.\\s\\-\\(\\)]|[0-9]+){3,24}$")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in a valid phone number.
